desc: Ideation: convex costs → greedy on marginal costs (2j−1)·P_i; binary search threshold T; answer = f(T) + (M − g(T)) // (T+1) where T is largest feasible threshold.
Implement solve() with fast input parsing, check(T) with early cost>M exit, doubling binary search for hi, final answer computation.

Verify correctness on sample 1 (expect 3) and sample 2 (expect 53) by mental/trace check; confirm edge cases: T=0 handling, k_i=0 products, hi doubling terminates (cost grows unbounded), Python int safety.
